outputs.explanation: Panel a contains schematic icons illustrating cropping/rotation/resizing and example micrographs; it is not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel b shows schematic and micrograph examples illustrating image spacing in figures; no averaged/summary plot is present.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating insets/magnification; there is no plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic and a series of micrographs at different contrast settings; no averaged data plot is present.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation examples plus micrograph/staining images illustrating channel annotation visibility; no plot of averages is present.
Panel f shows a schematic Venn-like diagram and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation; no averaged-data plot is present.

Panel g shows schematic calibration scale bars alongside micrographs/pseudocolor images to illustrate intensity legends; these are calibration scales, not plots of averaged data with variability, so the check does not apply.
